why: Meta is reviewing its 2030 net-zero deadline as it expands its AI infrastructure. Its report puts the 2025 rise in net emissions at 45% and traces most of the increase to purchased goods, services and capital equipment. That gives readers a way to assess the footprint of building data centers alongside the electricity they use. The disclosure drew coverage across business, climate and international news and adds a subject absent from our recent stories.

set_aside.why: Microsoft announced MAI Code 2 at Ignite on November 17. The pricing and performance warrant a closer look, but our November 19 story already covered a competing coding model release.
Portland’s proposal would pause new municipal AI contracts. The council hearing in December gives us a chance to report what city bureaus and residents say about the proposed limits.
